scope: Instrumentation-only restore timing diagnosis, old scheduling retained, real tools

method.clock: Darwin libc++ steady_clock and CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW; other platforms require separate validation
method.calibration: Same3 per-operation actual calibration tasks and past-label-only EWMA as E21; rotation by replicate
method.instrumentation: Parent fork/first output/reap, preparer thread/timer, worker queue/restore/finish/return, cleanup and final frontend/prefill; no policy change
method.attribution: Adjacent ordered timestamps partition preparation exactly; overlap is descriptive, no OS-internal causal attribution
method.costs: Initial history/load/calibration/oracles excluded and recorded; save/evict/real tools/repair/final suffix included

limits: Single M5/Metal/model and warm OS cache; no bandwidth/frequency/cold-SSD/Windows/CUDA inference
Stage wall time locates delay but cannot prove why a thread was paused
Three measured calls plus one included real file repair in compile tasks; scripted actions, not autonomous-model success
